purpose: The versioned, two-language acceptance fixture for the cross-repo identifier contract. Both the agentbox JavaScript bridge (management-api/lib/bc20-provenance-bridge.js) and the VisionClaw Rust crossing (src/uri/mod.rs) must reproduce every expectation below. Run it in BOTH CI pipelines before changing any shared primitive.

encoding_contract.input_bytes: UTF-8. The address is computed over the exact bytes of the input string; no Unicode normalisation is applied by either side.
encoding_contract.serialisation: The agentbox BC20 bridge hashes the incoming URN STRING. management-api/lib/uris.js stable-serialises a structured payload before hashing. These are different input contracts sharing one digest format; a fixture case states which is in use.
encoding_contract.digest: SHA-256, first twelve LOWERCASE hex characters of the digest, prefixed 'sha256-12-'.
encoding_contract.grammar: ^sha256-12-[0-9a-f]{12}$ — twelve lowercase hex characters, no more, no fewer. A precomputed address that only matches the PREFIX is INVALID and must be rejected at admission.

content_address.name: unicode-nfc
content_address.note: Composed form. Its address DIFFERS from the decomposed form below — neither implementation normalises, and that is the recorded contract, not an accident.

content_address.name: unicode-nfd
content_address.note: Decomposed form of the same grapheme. Different bytes, therefore a different address.

crossing.note: Execution addresses re-hash the whole URN string; the owner travels in owner_did and the mapping record, not in the identifier.

The JavaScript bridge crosses beads by structural pass-through (agentbox bead locals are already sha256-12 content addresses, identical to VisionClaw's bead shape). VisionClaw's ordinary crossing has no bead arm and refuses it via the wildcard. RESOLVED IN FAVOUR OF CROSSING by ADR-2061 (proposed); until the Rust arm lands, a bead that crosses one way and not the other must be reported as an explicit unmapped result, never a fabricated identity.
Deliberately unmapped WITHOUT elevation options. 'None' must surface as a visible unmapped result on both sides.

Memory elevation requires explicit domain/slug options. The Rust ordinary crossing deliberately returns None for memory; the elevation journey is a JS-side capability that has not been exercised as an end-to-end journey on either side.

precomputed_address_admission.name: empty-suffix
precomputed_address_admission.note: Prefix-only checking accepted this. The grammar requires twelve hex characters.

precomputed_address_admission.name: uppercase
precomputed_address_admission.note: Twelve LOWERCASE hex characters. Uppercase is a different byte string and must not alias.
